messages.author: 2a3a0c6a456f3043
messages.subject: maxit in colext
parts:
Hi all,

It seems like it should be easy but I can't seem to find the default value for maxit in the unmarked function colext. Does anyone know what it is or how to find it?

Thanks,
Dan

messages.author: 527d9b3ec7deff2d
messages.subject: Re: maxit in colext
parts: Looks like it has to do with the optimization function (optim).  If you look at the help for optim, you'll see that maxit defaults to 100 or 500, depending on the method.

messages.author: 527e14923215b7e4
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Re: maxit in colext
parts:
Hi Dan,

Yes, unmarked uses optim with method="BFGS" by default. You can changes the settings:

colext(~1, ~1, ~1, ~1, umf, method="Nelder-Mead", control=list(maxit=1000, trace=TRUE, [etc..]))

Richard
